$comment: The GITHUB_TOKEN permissions each workflow in .github/workflows/ may request. tests/test-workflow-permissions.sh reads every workflow and fails when one asks for anything not written here, when a workflow is missing from this file, or when an entry here names a workflow or job that no longer declares that block. So widening what a token can do takes two edits a reviewer sees side by side: the workflow and this file. 'workflow' is the top-level permissions block; null means the file declares none. 'jobs' lists only the jobs that declare their own block, and a job not listed must not declare one. A job with neither block would run with the repository's default token, and the test refuses that too. docs/risk-tiers.md puts this file in Tier 3; see docs/SECURITY-AI.md.
